Asset type: ONE original static strategic-game pixel-art asset for Theandril. Genuine transparent PNG alpha-zero background; no scenery, floor tile, checkerboard, text, labels, watermark, border or sprite sheet.
Style: serious weathered medieval dark fantasy; deliberate coarse square pixel clusters and broad midtone planes, restrained upper-left highlights, selective dark outlines. About 64x64 logical pixel detail shown enlarged, not a painterly miniature. No gradients, antialiasing, tiny texture confetti, glow or franchise designs.
Composition: shallow southeast three-quarter view (facing down-right) unless a front-facing insignia is specified. Entire silhouette and all equipment confined to the CENTRAL70% of a square canvas, at least15% genuinely transparent empty margin on EVERY side; nothing clipped. One isolated subject only.

Chalk-grey masonry and cloth with slate-violet fabric, black riveted reinforcements, straight ward-grid framing and kite shields. Simple original open-square insignia. Practical engineers and soldiers, no magical nullification, glow, anvil heraldry or stepped funerary terraces.
Subject: ONE compact Wardhall town cluster, a broad chalk-grey crenellated work hall flanked by two attached masonry workshops, slate-violet steep roofs and straight black riveted corner braces. Original open-square insignia inset above the rectangular hall door, sober practical wall geometry. No magic, dome, tower crown, funerary steps, anvil, terrain base or people;96x96 logical detail.
